dataList.name: 'O Clock
dataList.desc: Akhir Giliran: jika unit ini's [LimitedTime] is evenly divisible sebanyak 60, peroleh 2 [SlashDamageUp] dan 2 [PenetrateDamageUp] giliran berikutnya

dataList.name: Remaining Time
dataList.desc: Jika unit ini is in [TimeAcceleration] state, beri 10% of the damage it dealt Saat Menyerang as bonus damage in Skill's Sin Affinity (2 kali per giliran)

dataList.name: 'O Clock
dataList.desc: Akhir Giliran: jika unit ini's [LimitedTime], atau the sum of [OwnTime] is evenly divisible sebanyak 60, peroleh 2 [SlashDamageUp] dan 2 [PenetrateDamageUp] giliran berikutnya

dataList.name: Time Hyperacceleration
dataList.desc: Jika unit ini is in [EquitableDistribution] state, beri 10% of the damage it dealt Saat Menyerang as bonus damage in Skill's Sin Affinity (2 kali per giliran)

dataList.name: Time Hyperacceleration
dataList.desc: Akhir Giliran: jika unit ini is alive, beri 1 [Protection] giliran berikutnya to a acak Bagian on The Time Ripper.
